FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr: With these hands, I will create my victory!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefe: The shame of this… I'm red-faced…
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have scattered everywhere!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt: Excuse me! I'm trying to paint. Please keep out of my sight!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDef: This loss… I feel like I'm whiting out…
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos: GILLIAN? Please tilt your head slightly… There! That's the look I want!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr: Hmm… The angle, it is not quite there…
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefe: Oh… My feelings, they are blue…
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost:
The sky and the sea… They are so fickle.
Their changing expressions make them difficult to capture.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr: I am visiting my friend's retreat, if you must know.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost: I find it pleasurable to leisurely battle in the gentle sea breeze.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn: I'm thinking of having a pool made specially for POKéMON.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo: A pool would be nice, but I must say, a sun-room may be sublime.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt: I'm a good runner. I'm really fast!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos: When I run with the wind, it feels like I could fly!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro: I say, this marine life here at this resort agrees with me.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefea: That's a shocker! You must be joking.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB: Getting so serious over this… How nonsensical.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyTha:
SELPHY: Thank you.
You may go now.
